conceptual assets.information: The four-word cryptographic key stored in key_mem is used by the XTEA computation and can be programmed and read through the CSR interface.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Confidentiality is at risk because csr_rdata_o directly exposes a selected key word at line 185; integrity is at risk because csr_wdata_i can overwrite key_mem at line 179 and reset can clear it at line 176; availability is at risk because clearing or withholding the key prevents correct cryptographic operation through the key use at lines 236-238.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could read key_mem through csr_rdata_o or overwrite or clear it so subsequent XTEA operations use an attacker-chosen or unavailable key.

conceptual assets.information: The two 32-bit operand words received for an XTEA operation are captured and used as the cryptographic input data.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Confidentiality is at risk because rs1_i and rs2_i are captured into xtea.opa and xtea.opb at lines 205-206 and influence the returned computation at lines 222-238 and 249; integrity is at risk because the captured operands are changed by the load and reset assignments at lines 194-195 and 205-206.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could alter the operand values presented to the unit or exploit the returned result to disclose or corrupt protected plaintext or ciphertext data.

conceptual assets.information: The result word computed from the operands, key, and selected XTEA operation is returned to the processor.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Confidentiality is at risk because the computed result, which may be plaintext or protected ciphertext, leaves through result_o at line 249; integrity is at risk because xtea.res is computed by the arithmetic assignments at lines 222-224; availability is at risk because result production and release depend on the operation and completion conditions at lines 204-225 and 245-256.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could manipulate the operation inputs or control conditions to obtain an incorrect result or prevent a valid result from being released.

conceptual assets.information: The valid status indicates whether result_o contains a completed operation result, allowing the consuming processor to accept the result.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Integrity is at risk because result_select can assert or suppress valid_o based on rtype_i, funct3_i, and xtea.done at lines 245-256; availability is at risk because the same logic can withhold the completion indication and prevent the result transfer.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could cause valid_o to be asserted for an invalid result or withheld so the processor consumes stale data or waits indefinitely.

conceptual assets.information: The start command requests that the unit capture operands and begin an XTEA operation.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Availability is at risk because xtea.opa, xtea.opb, and the operation-completion state are only initiated when start_i is asserted at line 204, so withholding the command blocks operation progress.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could suppress or prevent start_i from being recognized so the coprocessor never produces a new result.

conceptual assets.information: The CSR write-enable decision controls whether incoming CSR data is allowed to change the cryptographic key storage.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Integrity is at risk because csr_we_i gates the key_mem update at lines 178-179, allowing an enabled write to replace key material; availability is at risk because the same gate can withhold the CSR key-programming transfer.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could force the write enable active to replace a key or suppress it so required key programming cannot occur.

conceptual assets.information: The CSR address selects which word of the four-word key is written or returned, and therefore determines which key portion a CSR access affects.
conceptual assets.rubric reason: Integrity is at risk because csr_addr_i indexes key_mem for both writes and reads at lines 179 and 185, so an altered selection can redirect an update to a different key word.
conceptual assets.attack: An attacker could alter the CSR address so a key update overwrites a different key word than intended.

considered, not kept.reason: active_i is only declared at line 26 and is never read or used by the RTL, so it is not information used or produced by this unit.
funct7_i is only declared at line 35 and is never read or used by the RTL.
rs3_i is only declared at line 38 and is never read or used by the RTL.

rtype_i and funct3_i fields that select the operation or result form are barred from being separate pieces by the operation-selector rule, with their effects used as part of the operation behavior at lines 204-225 and 245-256.
